proved_step: For f = e_s^T M_1(x_1)...M_n(x_n) e_t over any field F, with M_i(x_i) = A_i + x_i B_i and variables read once in fixed order 1..n: the commutative image is identically zero iff the non-commutative f is zero. Proof: the non-commutative expansion is sum_S c_S w_S with w_S = prod_{i in S} x_i (increasing indices) and c_S = e_s^T Y_1...Y_n e_t, Y_i = B_i for i in S and A_i otherwise; the commutative monomials prod_{i in S} x_i are distinct for distinct S, so all c_S = 0 is equivalent to f = 0. Consequence: zero-testing a commutative fixed-order ROABP reduces to non-commutative ROABP zero-testing (Raz-Shpilka 2005, deterministic poly time).
